caption: The drawing depicts a reddish-brown ceramic jar with wide, rounded sides and a slightly narrower, circular opening at the top. Large white numbers, forming "1768," are prominently painted or marked on the side of the jar in a broad, uneven script. The jar sits on a flat, horizontally textured surface that appears to resemble wood in gray tones. In front of the jar at its base, there is a separated lid of matching reddish-brown color with a central knob, which rests flat on the surface below. The background of the image is a plain, off-white or cream color. Above the drawing, the words "PRESERVE JAR" and "NUMBERS ON SURFACE OF JAR" are printed, with the numbers "1768" written in between, mimicking the style and color of the numbers on the jar itself.
title: Covered Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
